fields.submitted_link: The Amazon short link submitted by the operator, preserved byte-for-byte.
fields.slug_format_check: Objective check of the short-link slug against the ASIN format. Per Amazon's SP-API Catalog Items reference (https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/catalog-items-api-v2022-04-01-reference), an ASIN is a 10-character identifier; every submitted slug is 9 characters, so slugs are recorded as opaque tokens and are never treated as ASINs.
fields.intended_asin: Deprecated field name retained for schema compatibility. Holds the submitted slug verbatim; see slug_format_check. Not asserted to be an ASIN.
fields.official_listing_url: The official Amazon listing URL confirmed by resolving the submitted link (live fetch). Left blank when no product destination could be confirmed. Never merged with observed_redirect_target.
fields.observed_redirect_target: The exact final URL observed when the short link was fetched. Kept in a separate field from official_listing_url; the two are never merged.
fields.product_title: The listing title exactly as served by amazon.com on the confirmed date. No other attributes are recorded.
fields.confirmation_date: Date of the live verification fetch (UTC).
fields.status: verified when an official Amazon product page was reached; unverified otherwise.
fields.history: Preserved observations from earlier sessions. Never deleted; later observations do not overwrite earlier ones.

note: Do not claim that supplied short links are invalid; their exact compliance status as Associates Special Links is unresolved (FLG-003). One link per product should be tested in the enrolled Associates workflow before scaling (test-link step not yet performed; account access unavailable to this build).

irregularities: FLG-001: All five submitted slugs are 9 characters; Amazon ASINs are 10-character identifiers. Slugs are recorded as opaque tokens; ASINs are read only from resolved listing URLs.
FLG-002: No supplied link was observed to carry the tag shopnow047c-20; per-link tracking attribution is unconfirmed pending the enrolled-workflow test.
FLG-003: Compliance status of link.amazon short links as Associates Special Links is unresolved. Do not assert invalid; do not scale before the test.
FLG-005: One of five links consistently lands on a bot checkpoint; its listing identity is blank.

Transient-redirect note: two links resolved to the Amazon homepage on one session's fetch and to product pages on another session's fetch the same date. Both observations are preserved above; neither was deleted or overwritten.

Prices, ratings, review counts and commission rates are left blank: Associates policy conditions price display on Amazon-served or API-served data, which this static build does not have. Nothing was inferred.

FLG-016: Sessions disagree on which listing P-04 (B0c8moW59) and P-05 (B0f3GKalj) originally intended. This session and PR #27 both observed P-05 -> dp/B0DZFD6R9Z (CHEF iQ Sense); PR #27 observed P-04 -> dp/B0DHZTCNR5 (ThermoMaven thermometer), while another session reported the two destinations reversed. All observations preserved; identity mapping to be settled by the operator in the enrolled Associates workflow (SiteStripe test-link per product).
